title: Sir Galahad
summary: Sir Galahad was one of the Knights of the Round Table. He later undertook the quest for the Holy Grail and succeeded alongside Sir Bors and Sir Percival.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In ancient times, Sir Galahad served [[King Arthur]] as one of his most trusted [[Knights of the Round Table]]. He later undertook the quest for the [[Holy Grail]] and succeeded along with two other knights, [[Sir Bors]] and [[Sir Percival]]. {{source|Memory Lane}} A statue was built in honor of him and the other two knights alongside that of [[Sir Lancelot]] inside his [[Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot|Mausoleum]]. {{source|Memory Lane}}

Many years later, [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale]] observed Galahad and the other knights' statues before entering the hidden sanctuary. {{source|Memory Lane}}
